tagline: Unleashing innovation in drug discovery to develop life-changing medicines
hero_kpi_rationale: The drug discovery sector relies on technological innovation and R&D investment as the primary lever for value creation. This KPI captures Evotec's strategic commitment to scientific excellence and its differentiated platforms (AI, biology, omics).

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% revenue)
kpis.explanation: Share of research and development expenses in revenue.
kpis.description: Evotec focuses on scientific excellence and industrialization of its D&PD platforms to generate quality growth.
kpis.signal: Strong commitment to differentiated innovation through AI and technology platforms

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin, reflecting operational efficiency.
kpis.description: Gross margin is improving through better productivity and rigorous cost management.
kpis.signal: Sustained improvement driven by operational efficiency initiatives

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.description: Operating margin is improving significantly through the Priority Reset program and budgetary discipline.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement driven by cost reduction plans

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Reduction of 600 positions in D&PD between March 2024 and June 2025, exceeding initial target.
kpis.signal: Significant workforce reduction to improve efficiency

kpis.name: Investments (capex)
kpis.explanation: Expenditures on tangible and intangible investments.
kpis.description: Capex reduced in the context of a more capital-efficient model, notably via JEB.
kpis.signal: Moderation of investments aligned with model rationalization

kpis.name: Recurring revenue / subscription
kpis.explanation: Recurring revenue generated by long-term contracts and technology platforms.
kpis.description: Business model evolving toward integrated deals with risk and revenue sharing, increasing recurrence.
kpis.signal: Growth in recurring revenue through strategic partnerships and shared models

kpis.name: Cost reduction (annual impact)
kpis.explanation: Annual savings realized through operational efficiency initiatives.
kpis.description: Cost reduction target of €60M in 2025, of which €30M linked to Priority Reset and €30M to additional measures.
kpis.signal: Acceleration of efficiency gains beyond targets

kpis.name: Headcount reduction (D&PD)
kpis.explanation: Number of positions eliminated in drug discovery and development.
kpis.description: 600 positions eliminated between March 2024 and June 2025, exceeding initial target of 400.
kpis.signal: Deep restructuring for a more efficient model

risks.title: Dependence on a few major clients
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in 'Competitors and disruptive market participants' section, strong language on potential impact of key client loss, stable trend, high weight as 43% of revenue comes from 3 clients.

risks.title: Increased competition from low-cost CROs
risks.score_rationale: Present in 'Competitors and disruptive market participants', explicit language on pricing pressure, upward trend, central category for business model.

risks.title: Risks related to artificial intelligence
risks.score_rationale: Discussed in 'Competitors and disruptive market participants', strong language on obsolescence risks, upward trend, high weight due to accelerated innovation.

risks.title: Dependence on partnerships for monetization
risks.score_rationale: Present in 'Partnership risks', clear language on monetization uncertainty, stable trend, high weight as linked to pipeline valuation.

risks.title: Execution of strategic transformation
risks.score_rationale: Central in 'Strategic risks', very strong language ('execution risk', 'uncertainty', 'delays'), upward trend with Project Horizon, critical weight for future.

risks.title: Supply chain disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Detail in 'Macroeconomic risks', precise language on operational impacts, stable trend, high weight due to dependence on critical inputs.

risks.title: Cybersecurity of information systems
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in 'Cautionary Note' and 'Item 16K', concerned language, upward trend with growing threat, high weight due to R&D data sensitivity.

risks.title: Intellectual property protection
risks.score_rationale: Discussed in 'Cautionary Note' and 'Summary of Risks', strong language on IP infringement risks, stable trend, high weight for innovation.

ai_positioning.summary: Evotec integrates AI as a central lever in its drug discovery platforms, particularly through in silico modeling, target identification, and compound optimization. AI enhances productivity and quality of co-owned pipelines.
evidence: Use of AI for in silico design, disease modeling, and safety profiling
Development of AI and multi-dimensional data-focused partnerships
